actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent molecular identity: RNA shows a concentrated immune/inflammatory program (allograft rejection, interferon alpha/gamma, IL6-JAK-STAT3) with moderate-to-large effect sizes and FDR significance, and WXS shows strong BAP1 enrichment (36.7% vs 2.7%, OR=20.6, q=0.00031) with PBRM1 depletion. These are mutually interpretable axes rather than scattered weak findings. Membership is structurally compatible: no patient lacks positive modality support, WXS and RNA provide the strongest probe support, and resampling stability is moderate (ARI=0.68). No measured technical factor is significantly associated with the partition or with C0001 specifically, so a technical explanation does not dominate. Cross-modal silhouettes are near zero, but this is a continuous diagnostic that does not actively contradict the identity, and no positively supported Split or Merge is available. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is therefore better supported than Drop.

C0002 has a coherent molecular identity supported by mutually reinforcing WXS and CNV evidence: strong PBRM1 enrichment (70.4% vs 26.3%, OR=6.65, q=0.00308) together with a coherent 9p/9q loss pattern involving CDKN2A and JAK2 (FDR-significant continuous and gain/loss results). RNA support is limited to MYC targets v2, but a single strong modality is sufficient when the identity is coherent and not contradicted. Membership is structurally compatible: no patient has zero positive modalities, resampling stability is the strongest among the sets (ARI=0.81, PAC=0.37), and RNA/WXS/WSI provide the strongest probe support. No technical confounder reaches significance, and no positively supported Split or Merge is available. Retaining C0002 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.

C0003 has a coherent identity defined by broad, strong RNA differentiation (23 significant pathways, including down-regulation of allograft rejection and MYC targets and up-regulation of pancreas beta cells, heme metabolism, and TGF-beta signaling) and a strong, coherent CNV pattern of lower copy number at chr16p/16q and chr12p/12q with depletion of 9p/9q/CDKN2A/JAK2 losses. WXS shows no FDR-significant mutations, but this is absence of evidence in one modality rather than active contradiction, and the RNA and CNV signals are each substantial. Membership is structurally compatible: WSI, RNA, and CNV show positive modality silhouettes, no patient has zero positive modalities, and all internal probe silhouettes are positive. No technical confounder reaches significance, and no positively supported Split or Merge is available. Retaining C0003 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.

C0004 has a coherent identity defined by a strong, FDR-significant WXS pattern: marked PBRM1 depletion (4.2% vs 48.1%, OR=0.047, q=0.00138) and VHL depletion (25.0% vs 63.3%, OR=0.19, q=0.021), with a nominal TP53 enrichment. This is a concentrated, biologically interpretable axis rather than an isolated favorable observation, and WXS provides the strongest probe support (0.120) and the strongest modality silhouette (0.051) for this set. RNA and CNV show no FDR-significant differences, but that is absence of evidence rather than contradiction, and a strong single-modality-defined subtype can be retained. Membership is structurally compatible: no patient has zero positive modalities, and no technical confounder reaches significance. No positively supported Split or Merge is available. Retaining C0004 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.
